name: Context Meter
description: How much of an agent's context window is in use, by category, and how close the plan's usage limits are.

props.name: context
props.type: { used: number; total: number; segments: { label: string; value: number; color?: string }[] }
props.description: Tokens in use and the window size. Each segment is a category drawn in palette order (water, seafoam, wisteria, plum, yuzu) unless it has its own colour. Hovering a segment names it with its size.

props.name: limits
props.type: { label: ReactNode; resetsIn: ReactNode; value: number }[]
props.description: Plan limits as rows. resetsIn follows the word "Resets", for example "in 2 h 46 min" or "Tuesday 15:00". value is the percentage used.

props.name: warnAt
props.description: Percentage at which a limit's bar and number turn yuzu.

props.name: criticalAt
props.description: Percentage at which a limit's bar and number turn camellia.

props.name: className
props.description: Extra classes for the card. Other props go to the root section element.
